title: What Did Men Do to Deserve This?
author: Jessica Winter
review: I don't understand why people are suggesting on Twitter that this is a novel take. I do not like writing like this. I don't understand why so much mainstream writing about men and masculinity is so massively ungenerous. Like, why does this author lay out all of the negative things facing men and then basically just go, 'but these are also affecting women, so who cares?'. Like, why can't we imagine that a genuine shift in gender relations (whether superficial or not) over the last century or so could have genuine significance? Obviously these right wing manosphere fascist hacks are what they are. But jeez. Don't some things really have an effect? Not everything is a sham. I didn't think this was good.
